title: Evidence commits raw logs, not a digest receipt with key failing lines (#215)
symptom: A case run commits its raw log under .chough/artifacts/ beside the records, and its observation has no fingerprint and no key failing lines
trigger: Run the case, or evidence add --artifact <absolute path>, on Chough 0.5.0
expected: The raw log stays in .chough/local/logs/, and the committed entry gives the command, the output's SHA-256 and at most 20 key failing lines (REQ-records-005)
actual: The raw log is committed in .chough/artifacts/; no local log, fingerprint or key lines
impact: Committed raw logs carry local paths and noise, and a reviewer cannot see why a run failed without the log
source: GitHub issue #215, red on 0.5.0 by t38b at 69b56154 (leif/0.6.0-records-red)

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Green on integration after t37j's 45cc9853 and ad496d21: TC-records-proof-split-and-external passes (local logs with the command and the output's SHA-256, key failing lines, and an outside artifact fingerprinted in place under ext-<hex>).
